name: #include
description: #include is a passionate group of students at University of California, Davis that builds custom web solutions for local organizations. We serves two main purposes: to support local organizations by delivering high quality custom web solutions to establish their web presence, and to provide a collaborative environment where students of all skill levels can learn the fundamentals of web programming and UI/UX design. We are open to all majors and no prior experience is required. During Fall 2025, #include meets every other Tuesday from 8:00-9:00 PM in Walker 1310, starting on October 21st.

name: 180 Degrees Consulting at UC Davis
description: 180 Degrees Consulting aims to empower nonprofits and social enterprises by providing high-impact, pro bono consulting services delivered by student volunteers. Our mission centers on turning good organizations into great ones through strategic advice and a socially motivated mindset.

name: 27 Heartbeats
description: Our goal is to provide medical care to animals in need by collecting and distributing unused medical supplies, while offering students educational and hands on experiences with animals. We also aim to educate our community about the importance of animal welfare and wildlife conservation around the world. Members are notified about upcoming events / meetings and sign ups through club emails (typically sent out weekly). name: 3 Day Event Club at UC Davis
description: The 3 Day Event Club at UC Davis aims to foster a sense of community amongst collegiate equestrians and support our members in their persual of the eventing sport, regardless of skill or competition level.

name: 3D Enthusiasts of Davis
description: To connect people interested in sharing and learning with each other about 3D modeling, rendering, sculpting, and more and foster creative collaboration with club projects and events. First meeting Fall Quarter October 7th.

description: We believe that addiction awareness for all individuals reduces stigma. We aim to center the voices of our students in everything we do to advocate and ground our work in unity, where all individuals facing addiction do not face isolation and can seek harm reduction resources. We hope to educate peers- growing a community where we can support recovering students and more. We strive to create inclusive, compassionate spaces where education, open dialogue, and peer support are prioritized. name: Advanced Modeling Aeronautics Team
description: Advanced Modeling Aeronautics Team (AMAT) is an organization that teaches undergraduate students the necessary hands-on experience to design, build, and fly scale model remote-controlled (RC) airplanes. AMAT competes in the annual SAE Aero Design / AIAA DBF competition. We build and fly large, remote-controlled aircraft made primarily from composite materials such as carbon fiber, honeycomb aluminum, and foam. name: Adventist Christian Fellowship at UC Davis
description: Adventist Christian Fellowship is a student organization on campus dedicated and passionate about the life and ministry of Jesus Christ. Our purpose on campus is to exemplify the character and love of our Savior through fellowship and friendship.

name: Advocates for Missing & Exploited Children
description: Advocates for Missing & Exploited Children (AMEC) is dedicated to educating families, communities, and local officials by providing accessible prevention resources. Alongside our community outreach efforts, AMEC supports families of missing and exploited children by offering volunteer efforts and civic engagement in finding their loved ones. While our primary efforts are rooted in helping children and adolescents within our immediate communities, we are steadfast advocates for all children and approach every case with equal care and commitment.

name: Afghan Student Association
description: The Afghan Student Association (ASA) intends to promote awareness, tolerance, and peace in issues relating to Afghanistan in UC Davis and the surrounding communities. ASA recognizes that the gateway to achieving the ultimate goal of peace resides in knowledge and understanding. It is for this reason that the ASA's mission includes promoting an understanding of Afghan religion, culture, and politics.

name: African Diaspora Mental Health
description: This club will give additional assistance, empowerment, and opportunity for African Diaspora students to prosper, while also building a more inclusive and equitable campus climate.

name: African Graduate and Professional Students Association
description: Fostering a vibrant community, the African Graduate and Professional Students Association is dedicated to cultivating a forum for networking, collaboration, mentoring, and effective communication between African graduate students and professional students. Our mission is to provide a supportive platform that empowers scholars, encouraging both personal and professional growth while fostering a spirit of unity and shared opportunities.

name: Agape
description: Agape (ah-gah-pay; Greek for conditional love) is a non-audition dance crew at UCD that dances to experience and share the GREAT love and joy of God. Agape, created in 2012, is an all-styles dance group represented and founded on unconditional love. They strive to have fun, inspire others, encourage compassion, and spread this love they learned from Jesus Christ through dance. No auditions, no religious background, and no experience necessary to join. We just want to further the kingdom of God by going all out in dance and being a part of this overflow of love! Contact us at agapeucd@gmail.com

name: Aggie Baking Club
description: Aggie Baking Club welcomes bakers from every kind of background and culture, with any kind of skill level, and those who just love eating the yummy baked goods. We are dedicated to not only having a fun time over some muffins and madeleines, but also introducing bakers to recipes from different cultures and new ways of baking that include every kind of diet. We have meetings where we trade baked goods, watch parties of baking show favorites like the Great British Baking Show, baking parties, and more! Join Our Discord: https://discord.gg/hPKUvDKVBF

name: Aggie Barbell Club at UC Davis
description: At Aggie Barbell, we welcome lifters of all backgrounds and experience levels. Our mission is to create a supportive and inclusive community where every member can pursue their personal fitness goals. We strive to foster an environment of camaraderie and mutual growth through group lifts, gym visits, and social events. Whether you're a seasoned athlete or new to lifting, Aggie Barbell is committed to helping you build strength, confidence, and lasting friendships. Together, we lift each other up.

name: Aggie Bullet Journaling and Productivity Club
description: The Aggie Bullet Journaling and Productivity Club is a community of students at UC Davis who enjoy journaling as an outlet for productivity, organization, mental health and wellness, creativity, and academic success. We host workshops and social events to meet other bullet journalers and anyone else who is interested in learning what bullet journaling is all about. Come learn how you can use a bullet journal as a tool to help you achieve your personal and academic goals! Interested in joining? Visit our website at aggiebujos.carrd.co for the link to join our Discord server.

name: Aggie Fiction Writing Workshop
description: Aggie Fiction Writing Workshop aims to create a constructive literary environment where students feel welcomed and motivated to improve their creative writing. Our weekly workshops are student-run and student-led with a focus on fiction pieces, but all student-produced works are welcome. Students can volunteer to workshop their stories (finished or not) on specific dates and will have part of that week's meeting dedicated to comments and critiques for their piece. In addition, meetings will consist of free-write exercises and other activities designed to stimulate creativity. At Aggie Fiction,

name: Aggie Goth & Alternative Society
description: The Aggie Goth & Alternative Culture Society at UC Davis is a student-led organization dedicated to building an inclusive and expressive community for individuals who identify with or are interested in Goth culture and its related aesthetics, music, fashion, and philosophy. We aim to create a safe and welcoming space for creative expression, critical discussion, and social connection through events, meetups, and collaborations. We celebrate the diversity and depth of alternative identities and promote understanding of the Goth subculture within and beyond the UC Davis community.

name: Aggie House
description: Aggie House is an organization operating a student-run transitional housing shelter for UC Davis students experiencing housing insecurity and homelessness. Data from the ASUCD-GSA Housing Affordability and Insecurity Survey shows that over the course of the 2017-18 school year, 18% of UC Davis students experienced either homelessness or some form of housing insecurity. Our program seeks to address this issue by providing additional emergency shelter options for students, while also taking an innovative approach of being community-based, as well as volunteer and student-led. name: Aggie Hurricane Skating Club
description: The Aggie Skate Club, founded in 2019, exists to celebrate the art of skateboarding at our very own UC Davis Campus. Our mission is to foster connection, creativity, and stoke through skating while growing an inclusive skater community in our community.

name: Aggie International Ministry
description: We are a “home away from home” for international students all over the world. AIM stands for Aggie International Ministry; we are a Christian group at UC Davis. Whether you have beliefs or no beliefs and whether you are an undergrad or graduate student, visiting scholar or post-doc, you are welcome here! We gather together weekly in our homes to eat yummy food, study the Bible together, engage in thought-provoking discussions, and also make time to play fun games. Aside from our weekly gatherings, we also host various educational workshops to help international students adjust to living and st

name: Aggie International Ministry - Undergrad
description: AIM-Undergrad is an International Christian group on campus for undergraduate students. There exists a separate group for graduate students. :) We spend time learning the Bible, getting connected with other international Christian students, and having fun! We seek to build community that is encompassing, unique, and open. We meet regularly and hope to help international students transition to American life. Whether you want to learn about Christianity or looking to connect with other like-minded students, anyone is free to check us out!

name: Aggie Mahjong Club
description: The purpose of the Aggie Mahjong Club is to bring UC Davis students together to learn how to play and enjoy the game of Mahjong. The club will meet up to play recreational games of Mahjong while eating snacks and enjoying other refreshments. Students will learn about the history and culture of mahjong through playing and occasional seminars. Mahjong tournaments will be held each academic year so that students can put the skills they have gained to practical use and have fun!

name: Aggie Neurodiversity Community
description: The Aggie Neurodiversity Community (ANC) is a social community of undergraduate and graduate students, as well as general community members, who identify as neurodivergent. Neurodiversity is broadly and inclusively defined, no diagnoses necessary, so as to create as welcoming and diverse a space as we can. We work side-by-side with the Disabled Student Union, another UC Davis club, to create a space for disability cultures while supporting and empowering our communities. name: Aggie Open Mics
description: The purpose of this organization is to foster a space for students of diverse backgrounds to express themselves creatively and feel heard in various ways of expression, including but not limited to singing, dancing, poetry, and storytelling. Aggie Open Mics aims to allow for collaboration, friendships, and creating a community where we can be ourselves comfortably.

name: Aggie Poetry Club
description: The mission of the Aggie Poetry Club is to foster a community for those passionate about poetry. This club will allow those interested in poetry to connect with others through workshops, readings, and other fun events. Our meetings will be aimed towards promoting creativity, critical thinking, and self expression through the art of poetry and the dialogue surrounding it.

name: Aggie Polo Club at UC Davis
description: The Aggie Polo Club gives students the opportunity to learn the sport of polo along with horsemanship, barn management, and horse care. The club is student operated with the help of alumni volunteers. Practices and lessons will take place off-campus and include scrimmages and interactive clinics.

name: Aggie PreMed Mentorship
description: To facilitate connection between pre-medical undergraduates and UC Davis School of Medicine students for purposes of mentorship. Our mission is to provide information and advice about the process and steps needed in order to become a medical student. We also wish to provide mentors for those pre medical students that want to have a medical student share advice in a one-on-one type environment.

name: Aggie Propulsion & Rocketry Lab
description: Aggie Propulsion & Rocketry Lab (APRL) is a student-run bi-propellant liquid-fueled rocketry team. We are working towards building UC Davis's first-ever liquid rocket. Our project will enable students at Davis to design, build, test, and launch rockets for years to come. Our mission is three-fold. Make rocketry accessible to all students regardless of background or experience. Create a community of like-minded individuals sharing their passion for space and rocketry. name: Aggie Rally Committee
description: The purpose of this organization shall be to organize all rallies and activities of the student section, to act as the official guardian of the traditions and spirit of the University of California Davis, to represent the traditions of fair play, justice, and immense pride for the ideals of the University to the public, the students, and the alumni.

name: Aggie Society of Emergency Medical Technicians
description: The Aggie Society of Emergency Medical Technicians (ASEMT) is dedicated to fostering a scholarly society of current and aspiring emergency medical technicians dedicated to excellence in prehospital care. Our mission is to provide professional development, mentorship, and community service initiatives that equip future EMTs with the leadership, knowledge, and skills necessary to respond confidently in medical emergencies. name: Aggie Space Initiative
description: The Aggie Space Initiative (ASI) empowers UC Davis students to contribute to the future of space exploration through interdisciplinary collaboration, hands-on projects, and student-led innovation. We believe every field has a place in space exploration, and we bring students from all majors together through NASA competitions, research, and technical projects to tackle real challenges in human spaceflight and space systems.

name: Aggie Sports Analytics
description: Aggie Sports Analytics is a student-led organization redefining the future of sports technology. We unite driven students from diverse academic backgrounds to develop innovative solutions across business, technology, and media.

name: Aggie Wrestling Club
description: Our mission is to bring wrestling to UC Davis by building a welcoming and hardworking community for athletes of all skill levels. Whether someone is stepping onto the mat for the first time or continuing years of experience, we strive to create an environment that promotes growth, discipline, competition, and camaraderie through the sport of wrestling.

name: Aggie's Digital Asset Management
description: The objective of ADAM is to create a learning environment where the students of the University of California, Davis can learn and acquire knowledge on investing, stock markets, cryptocurrency, and blockchain technology through participating in study groups, mock trading in stocks and cryptocurrencies, practical sessions, and digital assets project development.

name: Aggiemation Eggheads
description: Aggiemation Eggheads is an animation club where students of all skill levels and backgrounds can learn to animate, collaborate on projects and/or meet new people! Currently, our club operates as a animation studio! We work as a team to create a finished animated film by the end of each academic year! Fall is Pre-Production, Winter Production, and Spring is Post-Production. name: AggieMed Bookworms
description: The mission of AggieMed Bookworms is to provide a place for all book lovers in the School of Medicine to meet and discuss non-medicine-related books and to attend book-related events (e.g., the Sacramento Book Festival, film adaptations) together.

name: Aggies for Israel
description: Aggies For Israel (AFI) is a student organization at UC Davis dedicated to showcasing the diversity and intersectionality of Israeli-Jewish culture. AFI welcomes to any member of the local community who believes in the existence of the Jewish State of Israel, regardless of ethnicity, gender, orientation, affiliation, or religion.

name: Aggies For The Arb (Cleaning Organization)
description: We are committed to preserving and protecting the UC Davis Arboretum, a cherished cornerstone of our campus community, through active stewardship, litter removal, and pollution reduction, ensuring this natural sanctuary remains a thriving, beautiful space for generations of Aggies to come.

name: Aggies Near and Far
description: Our organizational goal is to develop a podcast dedicated to promoting international collaboration, fostering cultural literacy, and highlighting the opportunities available to UC Davis students, faculty, and staff. The podcast aims to spark curiosity and reflections about how global learning shapes personal and academic growth. We interview students, faculty, visiting scholars, and members of the UC Davis community with diverse global backgrounds to amplify the voices and cultural experiences of Aggies. name: AggieWorks
description: AggieWorks is a student-run community of product managers, designers, and engineers, and marketers focused on building software products (web and mobile apps) for the UC Davis student body. We believe in helping the UC Davis community by creating solutions that solve student pain points and make college life easier. We hope that through AggieWorks and our products, we are able to help the student community get quality and reliable resources for education and so much more. description: The AI in Medicine SIG fosters meaningful dialogue and provides practical education around how artificial intelligence is actively reshaping healthcare. At the micro level, we focus on teaching students how to safely and effectively use current AI tools to enhance their daily studying and preclinical workflows. description: The AI Collective is a national network of student organizations dedicated to providing accessible AI & tech literacy through professional development programs and events. name: Alpha Tau Omega
description: Alpha Tau Omega’s mission is “to bind men together in a brotherhood based upon eternal and immutable principles, with a bond as strong as right itself and as lasting as humanity."

description: Alzheimer’s Buddies is a national student organization that responds to the isolation and social disengagement experienced by people in the intermediate to late stages of Alzheimer’s Disease. Through the course of weekly, one-on-one visits, our undergraduate volunteers provide companionship to dementia residents, break down communication barriers, and build bridges between families and their loved ones.

description: Our mission is to empower today's students by fostering a strong network of alumni who provide mentorship, guidance, resources, and opportunities based on our collective love of humanity. We will do both career fairs with companies we have made connections with and mentorship programs between current students and Davis alumni who have made it in the students desired fields.

description: Benefit environmental engineering and environmental science undergraduate students and related engineering and scientific disciplines; provide community, information, resources, and support to environmental engineering and science undergraduate students. description: American Cancer Society at UC Davis, formerly known as Colleges Against Cancer, is designed to help eliminate cancer by initiating and supporting the programs of the American Cancer Society on the college campus. name: American Indian Health Alliance
description: AIHA is dedicated to supporting Indigenous students in their journey into the health professions. Along with support for health professions, AIHA aims to support the Indigenous student community's overall wellness physically, spiritually, and socially.

description: The mission of the American Indian Science and Engineering Society (AISES) is to substantially increase the representation of American Indians and Alaskan Natives in engineering, science, and other related technology disciplines. description: We are the official student chapter of the American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics (AIAA) at the University of California (UC), Davis. name: American Institute of Architects for Students at UC Davis
description: The American Institute of Architects for Students (AIAS) strives for advancing leadership, design, and service among architecture students. Our vision for prospective architects includes a more sustainable, healthy, and equitable future through the empowerment of student voices, ideas, and actions. At UC Davis, the AIAS is meant to provide resources, career opportunity, and academic excellence in the architectural field.

description: The American Institute of Chemical Engineers (AIChE) is the world’s leading organization for chemical engineering professionals, with more than 40,000 members from 93 countries. description: The mission of the American Lung Cancer Screening Initiative is to promote lung cancer screening for people who are at high risk of developing lung cancer.

description: AMWA at UC Davis SOM is a local branch of a national organization whose goal is to advance women in medicine and improve women's health. description: The Muslim Medical Student Association (MMSA) aims to cultivate a vibrant collective environment and a strong sense of community that extends beyond our Muslim students to embrace all peers and colleagues. To foster understanding and collaboration among diverse backgrounds, we envision hosting innovative projects and inclusive sessions, such as interfaith dialogue workshops, health education outreach initiatives, and cultural competency training. name: American Red Cross Club at UC Davis
description: Guided by the mission of the American Red Cross, our mission is to prevent and alleviate human suffering in the face of emergencies by mobilizing the power of volunteers and the generosity of donors. The American Red Cross Club at UC Davis will learn, practice and exemplify humanitarian values through service projects upholding the Red Cross mission.

description: American Society of Microbiology (ASM) is a club dedicated to creating a community for students interested in microbiology at UC Davis. Our goal is to make research information and internship opportunities surrounding microbiology more accessible to students while forming networking connections with faculty and staff. Members of ASM get hands-on experience with academia, from assisting in labs to attending conferences to taking trips out into the field. Feel free to contact us for more information on Aggie Life! description: The American Society of Civil Engineers at the University of California, Davis strives to promote the professional success of future civil engineers. description: American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME) at UC Davis is dedicated to building a community of aspiring mechanical engineers. We strive to improve the quality of life through innovation, collaboration, and a passion for engineering, while inspiring others with the excitement of our field.

description: We are a student chapter of the American Water Works Association and aim to provide students of UC Davis with access to connections and professional development within the water industry. description: The goal of the interest group is to promote exploration of the broad specialty of anesthesiology. The SIG will host informational talks from faculty mentors, organize procedure workshops, and facilitate shadowing of anesthesiologists. Given the minimal exposure to peri-operative and pain medicine during third year clerkships at UC Davis, the interest group is an essential component of our school's commitment to training leaders in all areas of medicine.

Established in 1973, the DCPA was originally the governing body of local sororities who are also members of the National Panhellenic Conference. The DCPA currently comprises 9 chapters of National Panhellenic Conference sororities as well as one non-NPC sorority as an Associate Member. name: Davis Competitive Programming Club
description: The Davis Competitive Programming Club (DCPC) is a space for programmers of all levels to learn and work together in order to represent UC Davis in programming competitions such as the International Collegiate Programming Contest (ICPC). Through weekly meetings, members will improve their problem-solving skills, learn new algorithms, and build an algorithmic mindset. If you're interested in solving fun, challenging coding puzzles or want to train your competitive programming skills with others, consider joining DCPC!

name: Davis Country Line Dancing Club
description: Our goal is to teach the steps for country line dances, partner dances, and freestyle dances, such as swing and two-step so that students are better equipped to have fun on the dance floor. We meet once a week for dancing workshops where line and partner dances are taught, as well as holding quarterly social events and fundraisers! Check us out on Facebook and Instagram for updates! @_dcldc_

name: Davis Cube Club
description: UC Davis' Rubik's Cube club - come hang out to learn, solve, and share twisty puzzles! We do workshops, team-based events, collect new puzzles, travel to competitions together, and host our own official competitions here on campus! Discord: https://discord.gg/gasNGDh2Yu Linktree: https://linktr.ee/daviscubeclub

name: Davis Data Driven Change
description: To inspire social reform through collaborative art, design, tech & research.

name: Davis Data Science Club
description: The Davis Data Science Club is a professional student organization at UC Davis aiming to foster a greater data science community by connecting students with industry professionals, researchers, and faculty members. We hold multiple events every quarter to help students with data science skills, career development, and networking.

name: Davis Design Interactive
description: Davis Design Interactive is UC Davis’s first human-centered design organization. Our organization was founded out of a growing need to provide human-centered design and user experience opportunities to students exploring the field. Our goal is to provide and promote design education on campus in the form of hands-on projects, student-led workshops, industry panels, and more. We believe that inclusive, intersectional, and interactive design are the cornerstones of good design, and our organization embodies these core values.

name: Davis Deviants
description: We aim to be a community space where you can befriend other kinky people, learn about safe practices, and discover new things about yourself!

name: Davis Drag Club
description: To create a home for the drag community on campus, to help students develop their skills and craft as drag artists, and to have shows that are hosted and performed by UC Davis students.

name: Davis Economics Collective
description: Davis Economics Collective (DEC) is the only student-run organization at UC Davis that works directly with the Economics Department with the focus of fostering a community of undergraduates, faculty, and Davis Economics alumni. Our mission is to empower our members to connect with faculty, alumni, and each other through social events, and develop their professionalism through networking events, our Career Discovery Speaker Series, and skill-building workshops.

name: Davis Emergency Medicine Organization
description: The Davis Emergency Medicine Undergraduate Society is dedicated to fostering a community of aspiring healthcare professionals passionate about emergency medicine. Our mission is to provide educational resources, hands-on experiences, and networking opportunities that empower our members to excel in the field of emergency medicine. Through workshops, seminars, and community outreach, we aim to cultivate the skills, and knowledge necessary for the next generation of emergency medicine practitioners.

name: Davis Entrepreneurship Club
description: Our mission is to empower and educate students on the fundamental principles of business and entrepreneurship, fostering a dynamic learning environment that encourages self development, creativity, and practical application of business concepts. By providing insights from successful entrepreneurs and offering leadership development opportunities, we prepare our members to become business leaders.

name: Davis Filmmaking Society
description: Welcome to the Davis Filmmaking Society where we love to make movies! Our goal is to create a network of dedicated UC Davis filmmakers, writers, cinematographers, actors, and anyone who enjoys watching or creating movies. Our general meeting information for the fall quarter will be announced soon! Learn more about DFS on our official website, davisfilmmakingsociety.com, and stay updated on all our upcoming events on our Instagram @davisfilmmakingsociety.

name: Davis Hellenic Club
description: Our goal is to provide an environment for the ethnic Greek community to meet, socialize, network with and support each other, as well as sharing the community-building aspects of Greek culture with the wider UC Davis community. This includes hosting social events, such as Greek conversation/learning opportunities, Greek coffee sales and events, traditional folk dance lessons and presentations, backgammon tournaments, Greek sports watch parties, celebrating cultural holidays, and general socialization and networking opportunities within the wider Greek community.

description: The Davis Historical Fencing Club is dedicated to historical traditions of longsword and saber fencing. Join us for bi-weekly practices and lessons, intra-club fencing matches, and quarterly tournaments. name: Davis Injury Prevention Program
description: The purpose of the UC Davis Injury Prevention Program (UCDIPP) is to facilitate the maintenance of elderly longevity and mobility through weekly classes taught at senior residential facilities and potentially gymnasiums in the area. These classes will focus on teaching the fundamentals of balance, endurance, strength, and flexibility. Students will engage with the local community by creating individualized workout plans for geriatric clients based on ability and goals. name: Davis Journal of Legal Studies
description: The Davis Journal of Legal Studies is an undergraduate legal studies journal created to focus on, elevate, edit, and publish undergrad research and writing related to law, legal studies, and the justice system. It is a platform to elevate the research of undergraduate legal studies, defined as the interdisciplinary, academic study of legal concepts, institutions, and processes.

name: Davis Karate Club
description: Davis Karate Club is a community that learns and practices the art of Karate. There are many styles of Karate, but this club will focus on Shotokan. No Karate experience is required and anyone is welcome to join. Karate literally translates to “empty hand” in Japanese, and it is a martial art that originated in Okinawa. Together we will learn the techniques, katas (forms), and bunkai (application) of Shotokan. Most importantly, we wish to share the culture of Karate.

name: Davis Law Democrats
description: Create a space for civic engagement and professional community among students interested in Democratic values, public service, and the law.

name: Davis Marksmanship Society
description: The Davis Marksmanship Society exists as a venue where UC Davis students may be introduced to the shooting sports and firearms safety in a fun, safe, and professional environment.

name: Davis Medical Device Club
description: The purpose of the Medical Device Club (MDC) at UC Davis is to promote the field of biotechnology with emphasis on medical device technology and the design thereof. A medical device is a piece of equipment that aids in diagnosis, prevention, monitoring, treatment, or alleviation of a specific disease. The MDC organizes design competitions that are open to students from all majors.

name: Davis Nerf Club
description: Davis Nerf Club (DaNC) is a UC Davis club all about Nerf and Nerf-wars! We host weekly games every Saturday from 5 - 8 PM. Unless otherwise said on our Instagram or Discord server, we will be meeting on the bottom floor of the Death Star.

name: Davis Newman Catholic Center
description: As the only Roman Catholic community serving UC Davis students, we are committed to building a sense of community and hospitality where Christian faith can be developed, shared, and challenged; developing and enhancing ministry with students; and providing ongoing educational and faith development opportunities relative to Scripture, social justice, liturgy, prayer, and spiritual and personal growth.

name: Davis Outdoor Volleyball
description: The mission of this organization is to create an inclusive, welcoming, and supportive volleyball community for UC Davis students of all skill levels and backgrounds. Our goal is to provide opportunities for students to stay active, build friendships, develop teamwork and leadership skills, and participate in recreational volleyball in a respectful and encouraging environment. We are committed to promoting student well-being, belonging, and campus engagement while supporting the values of inclusivity, accessibility, and community that are central to UC Davis student organizations.

name: Davis Period
description: Davis Period destigmatizes, celebrates, and improves access to menstrual health through education, service, and advocacy. - EDUCATION We believe that education is key to enacting change and that we are stronger together. We host workshops created by our team members and in collaboration with other student organizations to highlight the complexity of menstrual equity and womxn’s rights in general. name: Davis Policy Collective
description: The mission of the Davis Policy Collective (DPC) is to equip students with the knowledge, skills, and experiences necessary to engage in the policymaking process. Through hands-on exposure to policy writing and research, we aim to empower students to champion on progressive policy ideas that address the nation’s most pressing issues. Through policy memo writing workshops, policymaker forums, collaborations with advocacy organizations, and an undergraduate policy journal, DPC offers students with opportunities to create meaningful change at the nexus of social justice and evidence-based policym

name: Davis Political Review
description: DPR is dedicated to providing a platform for student voices from all political, cultural, and academic backgrounds. While our editorial board is nonpartisan, we encourage every writer to express their opinions about political issues taking place at the state, national and international levels. Together, we strive to provide diverse and student-to-student perspectives that generate insightful and informative conversations about the world in which we live. name: Davis Practical Marksmanship
description: It is the Davis Practical Marksmanship club’s purpose to educate UC Davis newcomers and current competitors in the practical marksmanship sport, and in doing so educate these members in Davis Practical Marksmanship club’s three core principles: safety, proficiency, and sportsmanship. The Davis Practical Marksmanship club instills these values through presentations and classes led by local NROI and CADOJ certified instructors and competitors. name: Davis Pre Law Society
description: First and foremost, DPLS aims to provide and create resources to help our members fulfill their pre-law goals. More importantly, it is an opportunity for you to meet other like-minded students and make new friends in a new environment. DPLS was created in the winter of 2019 by six ambitious and motivated students. Since then it has grown into a solid community; now, we have over 150 members. As a club, DPLS hosts bi-weekly general meetings which seek to help prepare members for the law school application process, taking the LSAT, building professional and personal connections, and more. name: Davis Pre-Dental Society
description: The Davis Pre-Dental Society welcomes all students to learn more about the path to dental school and what a career in dentistry looks like. As a member of PDS, you have the opportunity to listen to presentations from dental schools and practicing professionals, network with the pre-dental community on campus, and engage in a variety of fundraisers, socials, school tours and manual dexterity workshops!

name: Davis Rewilding Society
description: A student-run organization dedicated to propagating, planting, and promoting the planting of native plants in and around Davis. Our goal is to foster a better understanding of our native biodiversity among students and the general public through participatory events, including organized planting and educational outreach. We hope to increase the sustainability of Davis's urban ecosystem by planting native, drought tolerant species. description: The Robotics Club supports teams of students working to create robots for fun and for local and national competitions. Project teams meet frequently, and give hands-on experience designing, constructing, and programming a robot. The Robotics Club supports teams of students working to create robots for fun and for local and national competitions. description: DRAGON seeks to provide UC Davis students and other members of the community free access to an open, diverse, and respectful space where people may express and engage in their interest of gaming. Check us out on the DavisWiki!

description: Our club practices at the Lake Washington Sailing Club in West Sacramento. We welcome new members and no experience is necessary to join. We teach new sailors the basics, and refine more advanced skills through racing. Our team competes in the Pacific Coast Collegiate Sailing Conference, and we race in venues such as Santa Barbara, San Francisco Bay, Morro Bay, and San Diego. If you are interested, feel free to send us an email and we can get back to you with the time and place of our weekly meetings!

name: Davis Scuba
description: Davis Scuba is a student-run organization at the University of California, Davis, dedicated to building a strong community of divers and ocean advocates. Our mission is to promote scuba diving, marine conservation, and environmental awareness while connecting students with opportunities to explore the stunning underwater ecosystems along the California coast and beyond. We organize dive trips, provide mentorship and advice, and support members through the certification process. name: Davis Sim Racing
description: Founded in 2026, Davis Sim Racing is a student operated club at UC Davis that aims to foster community via education, entertainment, and competition in sim racing for all skill levels.

name: Davis Smash Ultimate Club
description: To host tournaments for the video game Super Smash Brothers Ultimate on campus so that fans of said game can make friends, improve at the game, and have fun.

name: Davis Songbirds
description: Davis Songbirds is an ever-growing community of singer-songwriters at UC Davis. Singer-songwriters of all skill levels are welcome to work on their writing skills and perfect their genre of songwriting. Members are encouraged to come and share their ongoing projects and collaborate with other artists. The Songbirds will meet weekly and hold songwriting workshops and jam sessions for all UC Davis students to showcase their original compositions and lyrics.

name: Davis Swing Dancers
description: We are bringing vintage swing dancing to the Davis community by teaching FREE beginning swing lessons on Monday nights from 8:00-9:00 pm, followed by social dancing from 9:00-10:30 pm in Giedt 1001. Bring friends, come and meet new friends, and just dance! Follow our Instagram and join our Discord for the most up to date events and updates. Swing on by!

name: Davis Touhou Project Club
description: Touhou Project is one of the most well-known subculture on the internet nowadays known for the dedication on promoting East Asian folk lore in a unique way and countless fan contributions to a fantasy world created by its creator: Jun'ya Ota (Zun). As a respond to the wishes of several students in the campus of wanting to have a touhou-related club, this club is therefore established to provide a welcoming and inclusive where students who liked touhou-project can find each other, share works to each other, and enjoy more products of this series.

name: Davis Triceratops
description: Davis Triceratops' purpose is to create a fun and welcoming community of members that all search for one thing: cute, handmade, crocheted triceratops. We host daily scavenger hunts and monthly large-scale events for members to search for and claim exclusive dinos, which offers UCD students opportunities to meet new people or to spend quality time with their friends. We aim to bring students together, explore, and better the campus through engaging in a stress free, enjoyable activity that serves as an escape from the average busy college student's life.

name: Davis Undergraduate Engineering Network
description: The Davis Undergraduate Engineering Network’s (DUEN) mission is to help UC Davis students studying or interested in engineering develop professionalism, camaraderie, and community service. Our members will interact with students and professors of various engineering disciplines, find and share internship/research opportunities, and explore common goals and ambitions for our students. DUEN will support the interests and passions for our diverse community of engineering scholars.

name: Davis Women in Business
description: Davis Women in Business (DWIB) empowers women to become successful leaders in their desired career fields. Through DWIB, members find career direction, develop professional networks, achieve ambitious career goals, and create lifelong friendships.

name: Davis Wushu
description: Promote and encourage the practice of wushu and introduce the art of wushu to newcomers, and to promote safety and fellowship. Provide safe and constructive practice of wushu under qualified supervision. Train members for competition and performance.

name: Davis Yugioh
description: This club is to promote the Yugioh trading card game and allow people with similar interest to meet and have fun while playing and discussing the game.

name: Debate at UC Davis
description: At Debate at Davis we are committed to giving all members the best possible experience in their public speaking journey. We provide enlightening (Competitive), enjoyable (Fun), and educational (Life Skill) opportunities. We are committed to serving everyone, from people who are looking to be competitive in the NPDA (National Parliamentary Debate Association) to those who have never given a speech in public. Our three-tiered model of competitive, educational non-competitive, and social events give everyone a safe space to move forward on their debate and public speaking journey.

description: THE PURPOSE OF DELTA DELTA DELTA shall be to establish a perpetual bond of friendship among its members, to develop a stronger and more womanly character, to broaden the moral and intellectual life, and to assist its members in every possible way. Delta Delta Delta is a Panhellenic sorority on the UC Davis campus. Founded at Boston University in 1888, we were also the first sorority at UC Davis. description: "Delta Gamma offers to women of all ages a rich heritage based upon principles of personal integrity, personal responsibility and intellectual honesty. Its primary purpose is to foster high ideals of friendship, promote educational and cultural interests, create a true sense of social responsibility, and develop the finest qualities of character."

name: Delta Sigma Theta Sorority Inc, Lambda Xi Chapter
description: Delta Sigma Theta Sorority, Inc. was founded on January 13, 1913 by 22 devastating divas on the campus of Howard University. The mission of the organization falls under the "5 Point Thrust": Economic Development, Educational Development, International Awareness and Involvement, Physical and Mental Health, Political Awareness and Involvement. Through these programs, Delta Sigma Theta aims to serve the broad and diverse needs of the African American Community.

name: Desi Student Association
description: The Desi Student Association of the University of California, Davis was created as an outlet through which South Asian students can come together to help raise awareness and celebrate the South Asian culture and heritage. description: Our mission at Disaster Medicine Interest Group (DMIG) is to empower medical students with the skills and knowledge needed to respond effectively to disasters and emergencies. We hope to share our love and passion for K-pop with our audience while emphasizing teamwork and unity among our members and our online community.

Spanish is the second most spoken language in the world and the primary/native language for 11 million Californians. name: Emergency Medicine Research Associates Program
description: This program is intended to assist the clinical research activities in the UC Davis Department of Emergency Medicine. Students assist Clinical Research Coordinators in screening and enrolling in over twenty active emergency medicine studies.

name: Emergency Medicine Student Interest Group
description: The Emergency Medicine Student Interest Group (EMSIG) was established in 1999 to promote interest in the practice of Emergency Medicine among the students of UC Davis School of Medicine. Emergency Medicine is a dynamic and growing field that holds many opportunities for students. Through interaction with clinical faculty EMSIG hopes to educate medical students about the specialty of emergency medicine and its importance in the medical field as well as provide information regarding career options and emergency medicine training programs.

name: Empowered Arab Sisterhood- Epsilon Alpha Sigma
description: The Beta chapter of the Empowered Arab Sisterhood-Epsilon Alpha Sigma, the first Arab sorority at UC Davis. The purpose of this sorority shall be to unite it's members in a sisterhood based upon the bonds of sincere and lasting friendship, to stimulate one another in the pursuit of knowledge and success, to promote the moral and social culture of it's members, and to develop plans for guidance and unity in action. description: Engineers Without Borders (EWB) @ UC Davis is a non-profit, student-run organization established to help developing areas worldwide with their development needs, while involving and training internationally responsible students. We are a chapter of the international organization, EWB-USA.

name: English Graduate Student Association

Primarily focused and run by graduate students in the department, we aim to serve the department's community of students, faculty, staff, and friends in the wider university community.

description: The Entomology Graduate Student Association is run by and for graduate students in the UC Davis Department of Entomology and Nematology. Our objectives are to connect students from across disciplines, inform students of and provide opportunities for academic success, and to serve as a bridge between students and administration. We also plan and fund social and academic events for students, faculty, and staff to enhance social and intellectual cohesion and to connect our department with the community at large.

name: Environmental Club at UC Davis
description: The purpose of the Environmental Club at UC Davis is to meet other students with similar interests and to stay informed about environmental issues. The club also encourages interaction with the local environment through outdoor activities and conservation service projects, as well as socials and guest speakers. All majors are welcome!

description: ELS provides a forum for environmental information and networking. The members attend community events, regional conferences, and discuss pending legislation. We network with the professional community for support, guidance, and information about environmental law. Students are encouraged to explore a variety of environmental and natural resource issues. ELS hosts an annual Environmental Law Conference where speakers and practitioners discuss current issues in environmental law. description: The Environmental Project Team builds a water treatment system for the competition but also builds knowledge, confidence, and friendships. Participants in the Environmental Project get exposure to the Environmental Engineering field; providing practical engineering design experience, project management skills, teamwork, and many other skills not found in school. description: The EMC exists to provide students in the School of Veterinary Medicine with hands-on, extracurricular exposure to equine medicine, surgery, and reproduction. We also believe in community education and strive to provide quality educational programs for horse owners, breeders, and riders.

description: Equity in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, and Entrepreneurship (ESTEME) is a graduate student organization dedicated to improving equity and inclusion in STEM fields and entrepreneurship. description: The Ethics Bowl team at UC Davis will foster rigorous, respectful, and collaborative engagement with the ethical questions that shape our personal lives, professions, and communities. Through preparation for and participation in Association for Practical and Professional Ethics's intercollegiate Ethics Bowl competition, we cultivate moral reasoning, intellectual humility, and the ability to articulate and defend positions while genuinely understanding perspectives we may not share. We believe in providing the utmost care for animals, while working to ensure a healthy, wholesome and safe food supply to benefit the world. We have the unique responsibility to bring sound scientific evidence to our future clients and to educate the consuming public about the food they eat. This mission begins in school and continues throughout our careers as food animal practitioners.

This fashion show helps convey the strength of the Design Department and talent of the students. We also help educate about the fashion industry, current fashion news, portfolio building, scholarship and internship opportunities as well as fashion design graduate school options.

description: Health outcomes are heavily shaped not only by clinical care, but by the social, cultural, historical, and structural factors that influence patients' lives. description: Founded in 2019, MS4SF is dedicated to uniting medical students invested in the health of our planet and patients and providing them with tools to make a difference at their institutions and in their communities through advocacy, curriculum reform, research, and climate-smart health care.

description: Our mission is to represent the interests of the Mexican graduate student community at UC Davis and to offer them a space to share academic, cultural and recreational activities.
